title: tests/cli fail with huggingface_hub 1.22.0: 'HFCliTyperGroup' object has no attribute '_add_completion':
author: Madhav-000-s

comments.author: dhruv7477
comments.body:
Root-caused this. Since `huggingface_hub 1.22.0` (released 2026-07-03), `typer_factory` returns hub's own click command group (`HFCliTyperGroup`) instead of a `typer.Typer`.

Two distinct breakages:
1. **The 6 CI failures**: `tests/cli/conftest.py` drives the app with `typer.testing.CliRunner`,
   whose `invoke()` calls typer's `get_command()` and reads `._add_completion` — an attribute
   only real `Typer` instances have → `AttributeError`. (`transformers env` works interactively
   because direct invocation never goes through `get_command()`.)
2. **A runtime bug behind it**: `serve`'s `--reasoning` declares its default as the enum member
   `ReasoningMode.AUTO`; click validates defaults against the string choices and rejects it, so
   `transformers serve` itself fails under hub 1.22.0 — not just the tests.

Fix for both in #47064: drive the app with `click.testing.CliRunner` (identical `invoke`
signature; the app is a genuine click group now) and default `--reasoning` to the enum's value.
`tests/cli`: 6 failed → 74 passed, 0 failed.
